title: Coastlines (USACE IENC)

current_bts_item.description: Public IENC item describes bi-monthly USACE/AGC updates and links the official feature-class service and master geodatabase. Its modified timestamp is not treated as a layer release date.

prior_bts_item.observation: Anonymous access denied in prior source inspection; continuity to the current catalog record is not accepted.

source.relationship: Current public BTS item is distributor evidence for the official USACE IENC service. Succession from the inaccessible prior item and historical HIFLD/DataLumos equivalence remain unverified.

observed.coverage_scope: Complete current COASTLINE_LINE feature class; inland chart coverage only, not nationwide coastline coverage.
observed.source_release_date_unknown_reason: Layer metadata provides no source edition or release date; the BTS update cadence does not date this snapshot.

candidate.geometry_policy: Retain native source coordinates and polyline paths without reprojection or repair.
